query:
SELECT gr.matchupId, gr.round, gr.isComplete, gr.isScored, gr.winnerId, t.name as winner,
  COUNT(p.id) as pick_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.isCorrect IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as scored_picks
FROM gameResults gr
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = gr.winnerId
LEFT JOIN picks p ON p.matchupId = gr.matchupId
WHERE gr.round = 'round32' AND gr.isComplete = 1
GROUP BY gr.id, gr.matchupId, gr.round, gr.isComplete, gr.isScored, gr.winnerId, t.name
ORDER BY gr.matchupId;
